en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on the Alms Bowl.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks, sitting on the ground, taught the Dhamma to one who was seated on a seat...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I shall not teach the Dhamma while sitting on the ground to one who is not ill and is seated on a seat.
One should not teach the Dhamma while sitting on the ground to one who is not ill and is seated on a seat.
Whoever, out of disrespect, sits on the ground and teaches the Dhamma to one who is sitting on a seat and is not ill, commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it is unintentional … [and so forth] …
the eighth training rule is concluded.
